name: Matsunami Shin'ichirou
source: A young man who works at a Shinto shrine as a Priest, along with his two younger Miko sisters. In an attempt to protect his sisters from the vengeful goddess, his soul ends up being destroyed, but his body is intact. As a side effect, he becomes flared with libido frequently.
